smoke: Fix round 2: throwaway headless Chromium (Playwright from e2e/node_modules, vite build served statically from a plain node http server, /api stubbed with page.route, 12 transaction rows and 3 disputes, signed in as linked; no Compose stack, so no stack lock) on /transactions and /disputes at 320 and 360 px with root text 100, 150 and 200%, for this tree and for a build of f6193f5 (main). Page end: scrolled to the bottom, the footer ends above the top of the bar in all 12 cases, in both trees (0 px under the bar; the bar is 58, 86 and 114 px tall, one row). Keyboard walk (Tab from the top, 8 stops on /disputes, 17 on /transactions): no focused link wholly under the bar in all 12 cases, in both trees; the only partial overlaps are 2 stops on /disputes at 320 px and 200%, identical in main. Horizontal page overflow: 0 in all 12 cases for this tree; main overflows 19 px at 320/150%, 132 px at 320/200% and 92 px at 360/200% (the header row wrap fixes it). Not measured this round: the tab bar segments at 320 px and 200% text, where main's one-row bar pushes Disputes partly off-screen (known, carried, back in lows.md). M1: Vitest only (jsdom); not run against the real API. The earlier Chromium numbers (rounds 0 and 1) for the other rows are not repeated.

standards.mechanism: Outline width as one theme token read with Tailwind border-(length:--outline-width)
Active OTP cell second pixel as inset-ring (box-shadow), border stays 1px
Session warning initial focus through the Radix AlertDialog Cancel part
Alert dialog pattern: focus moves into the dialog, Tab stays inside
Validation mode onTouched: first check on blur, then on every change
Field label dimmed with the CSS :has() relational pseudo-class (Tailwind has-disabled)
Absolutely positioned flex child static position (Header comment)
Reflow and text resize: wrapping header row and button labels, wrap-anywhere hero amount, grid track share caps
Inline link keeps its text size
Code error cleared from the controlled field onChange (React Hook Form Controller field.onChange then clearErrors), because input-otp onComplete fires only when the value grows to 6
